proof_text: Say: He is Allah, the One.
aqeedah_belief: He is, and has always been, one, without anyone else with Him. He is unique and there is no one like Him in His being, just as He is unique in His attributes, actions and Lordship. He is the only One who deserves to be worshipped.
salah_usage: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas daily so focus remains on Allah alone.
dua_usage: Ask Ya Al-Ahad to remove distractions that compete with worship.
dhikr_usage: Tasbihkan Ya Al-Ahad agar setiap perancangan kembali kepada tujuan Ilahi.
when_to_invoke: Use it whenever you focus worship solely on Allah.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ahad is the Unique One who is completely alone and singular in every possible sense. Understanding this name reminds the believer that Allah has no equal or partner in His self, His attributes, or His absolute divinity.
description_en: Al-Ahad reminds us that Allah's mercy surrounds every creature and heals every wound.
description_ms: Al-Ahad mengingatkan bahawa rahmat Allah meliputi setiap makhluk dan menyembuhkan setiap luka.

aqeedah_belief: He is the All-Strong, All-Dominant who reigns supreme over His creatures. He has subjugated all His creatures, all of whom have humbled themselves before Him and have totally submitted to His authority.

english_meaning: The Tremendous One or the Magnificent
proof_text: He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.
aqeedah_belief: This name comprises all attributes of greatness, majesty and glory. He is the Greatest and Tremendous in His Being, names and attributes, and thus none of His creation deserves to be exalted with the heart, the tongue and all body parts as He should be.
salah_usage: Visualise all creation bowing with you when mentioning this majestic Name.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Azim to humble the ego whenever praise comes your way.
dhikr_usage: Bertasbih dengan Ya Al-Azim selepas solat agar kemuliaan kembali kepada-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Reach for it whenever you must humble yourself before Allah's greatness.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghazali explains this name as an essence that completely transcends the limits of human perception and imagination. Its true tremendousness is beyond what the eye or the human intellect can capture — the believer's only response is awe and humility before what cannot be fully grasped.

proof_text: Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One whose knowledge is comprehensive and extends to everything seen and unseen, apparent and hidden. Nothing whatsoever is hidden from Him and He knows what was in the past, what is in the present, and will be in the future.
salah_usage: Recite this Name before salah to remind yourself that He knows your heart's condition before you speak a word.
dua_usage: Fear the One who knows the "treachery of the eyes."

when_to_invoke: Fear the One who knows the "treachery of the eyes."
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghazali counsels that the pursuit of knowledge is only praiseworthy when it draws one closer to God. proof_text: …He is the Most High, the Magnificent.
aqeedah_belief: Allah has absolute highness in every sense above all else—highness with regard to His Being, majestic position, attributes and absolute dominance. He is high above His creation and everything and everyone is under His absolute control and superior authority.
salah_usage: In ruku and sujud, reflect on His absolute exaltedness above all creation — let this move you to deeper reverence.
dua_usage: Humble yourself before His highness.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Al-'Aliyy ketika merasa rendah diri agar sedar bahawa kemuliaan hakiki hanya milik Allah.
when_to_invoke: Humble yourself before His highness.
ghazali_insight: Al-Ghazali explains that absolute, eternal exaltedness belongs solely to God. While all other things may be 'above' something comparatively, only God is above everything necessarily and without qualification — the believer therefore seeks elevation through closeness to Him, not through rank among creation.
description_en: Allah has absolute highness in every sense above all else—highness with regard to His Being, majestic position, attributes and absolute dominance. He is high above His creation and everything and everyone is under His absolute control and superior authority.

english_meaning: The Independent One Who is free of all needs
proof_text: Glory be to Him! He is self-sufficient.
aqeedah_belief: Allah is so generous that His immense generosity reaches all His slaves. He grants whatever he wills to whomever He wills. This includes guidance to His true religion, sustenance and cure from diseases.
salah_usage: Raise your hands after salah accepting whatever provision Allah decrees.
dua_usage: Say Ya Al-Ghaniyy when asking Allah to sustain your family and community with halal rizq.

when_to_invoke: Invoke it whenever you feel uncertain about rizq and resources.
ghazali_insight: A person can only attain a figurative share of this attribute by becoming completely free from needing anything other than God. proof_text: Then know that Allah is your Protector—an excellent Protector and an excellent Helper!
aqeedah_belief: Allah grants victory to whomever of His believing servants He pleases; no one will overcome those Allah helps, nor will anyone be able to help those Allah forsakes.
salah_usage: Make du'a in salah knowing He is An-Naseer — the Helper who grants victory to those who strive sincerely for His sake.
dua_usage: Seek His help against enemies and your own lower self.

when_to_invoke: Seek His help against enemies and your own lower self.
ghazali_insight: An-Naseer is the divine Helper who secures ultimate victory for the believers and casts terror into the hearts of their adversaries. Recognising this attribute gives the believer immense courage, knowing that God alone makes their feet firm and grants success when they face opposition.
description_en: Allah grants victory to whomever of His believing servants He pleases; no one will overcome those Allah helps, nor will anyone be able to help those Allah forsakes.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.81; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

proof_text: Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.
aqeedah_belief: He embraces everything in mercy and knowledge, His sustenance reaches all His creation without exception and no one is capable of praising Him as much as He has praised Himself.

ghazali_insight: A person shares in this name by actively expanding their knowledge and developing a vast, accommodating character. proof_text: …Allah is the Doer of Good and He loves [to see His slaves] do good.
aqeedah_belief: He provides whatever He has created with countless blessings and the One who has perfected, sustained, and guided everything He has created.
salah_usage: Ask freely in salah — He is Al-Jawaad, whose generosity encompasses even those who turn away from Him.
dua_usage: Be generous with your wealth and knowledge.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Al-Jawaad ketika memohon hajat agar hati yakin bahawa kemurahan Allah meliputi semua hamba-Nya tanpa sempadan.
when_to_invoke: Be generous with your wealth and knowledge.
ghazali_insight: Al-Jawaad is the Munificent One whose limitless generosity covers all of existence, giving liberally even to those who obstinately reject Him. Reflecting on this boundless generosity inspires the believer to eagerly anticipate the unimaginable delights He has prepared for His faithful servants in paradise.
description_en: He provides whatever He has created with countless blessings and the One who has perfected, sustained, and guided everything He has created.

aqeedah_belief: He is the One who judges amongst His slaves, in this life and in the hereafter, with absolute fairness and equity, based on (1) His universal will, (2) His religious legislation and (3) His reward and punishment.

dhikr_usage: Ulang Ya Al-Hakam sebelum membuat keputusan besar agar keputusan menepati keadilan.

english_meaning: The One Who honourably disdains anything unbecoming His mercy and generosity
bahasa_meaning: Yang Memiliki Sifat Malu Yang Mulia
proof_text: Allah, Glorified and Sublime be He, is modest and concealing, and He loves modesty and concealment…
aqeedah_belief: Allah is free of any imperfection. He is good and pure in His being, His actions, His names and His attributes. He loves those who are good and pure and accepts only that which is good and pure.
salah_usage: Approach salah with humility knowing He will never leave a sincere supplicant empty-handed out of His noble forbearance.
dua_usage: Be shy to sin against Him. Have high hopes when making Dua.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Hayyiyu ketika memohon keampunan agar hati yakin Allah terlalu mulia untuk membiarkan hamba-Nya kembali hampa.
when_to_invoke: Be shy to sin against Him. Have high hopes when making Dua.
ghazali_insight: Al-Hayyiyu signifies the One who possesses honourable shame and graciously disdains to ever leave a supplicating servant empty-handed. This profound attribute reassures the believer that God's extensive mercy and forbearance will cause Him to gently cover and pardon their faults, rather than exposing them to disgrace.
description_en: Allah is free of any imperfection. He is good and pure in His being, His actions, His names and His attributes. He loves those who are good and pure and accepts only that which is good and pure.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.161; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

proof_text: All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
aqeedah_belief: He is the creator, the owner and disposer of all affairs who bestows His blessings upon His creatures and looks after His righteous servants by setting their hearts aright. This name must not be attributed to other than Allah, Exalted be He. However, when used to refer to other than Allah, it is alw
salah_usage: Begin each salah recognising His constant nurturing of your life, faith, and every breath you draw.
dua_usage: Acknowledge His lordship by submitting to His commands.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Ar-Rabb untuk memperbaharui rasa syukur atas tarbiyah Allah yang berterusan dalam setiap aspek kehidupan.
when_to_invoke: Acknowledge His lordship by submitting to His commands.
ghazali_insight: Allah is the Lord and Master who nurtures and rectifies the affairs of all creation through the continuous favours He showers upon them. A believer recognises Him as the sovereign owner who alone creates, controls, provides for, and guides His servants.
description_en: He is the creator, the owner and disposer of all affairs who bestows His blessings upon His creatures and looks after His righteous servants by setting their hearts aright. This name must not be attributed to other than Allah, Exalted be He. However, when used to refer to other than Allah, it is always used in the genitive case, to mean 'the owner or proprietor of something', such as rabb al-'usra
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.7; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

proof_text: Allah is gentle and loves those who are gentle. He gives for gentleness that which He does not give for harshness.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One who graciously gives favours and gifts even before He is asked. He is the One who shows kindness to His creation by bestowing His blessings upon them and providing them with everything they need. He also bestows His kindness on the righteous believers by guiding them, assisting them an
salah_usage: Approach salah gently, knowing Allah is Ar-Rafeeq — He created the universe with deliberate gentleness and wisdom.
dua_usage: Be gentle in your dealings; violence does not adorn anything.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Ar-Rafeeq dalam doa agar dianugerahkan kelembutan dalam hati, pertuturan, dan pergaulan sesama manusia.
when_to_invoke: Be gentle in your dealings; violence does not adorn anything.
ghazali_insight: This name highlights Allah's absolute gentleness with His servants and in all of His actions. This divine gentleness is perfectly reflected in how He created the universe in deliberate stages, entirely in accordance with His infinite wisdom.
description_en: He is the One who graciously gives favours and gifts even before He is asked. He is the One who shows kindness to His creation by bestowing His blessings upon them and providing them with everything they need. He also bestows His kindness on the righteous believers by guiding them, assisting them and granting them true faith.

proof_text: [You are] the Supremely glorified, the Holy. [You are] the Lord of the angels and of Jibreel.

salah_usage: Glorify Him in ruku with Subhaana Rabbiyal 'Adheem, honouring the One whom the angels ceaselessly venerate.
dua_usage: Glorify Him frequently, especially in bowing and prostration.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Subboohun Quddoos ketika bertasbih agar hati sentiasa menyucikan Allah daripada segala sifat yang tidak layak bagi-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Glorify Him frequently, especially in bowing and prostration.
ghazali_insight: This name points to the One who is supremely venerated and rightfully declared completely free from any deficiency or flaw. It represents a state of absolute divine perfection, which is why the noble angels continually venerate Him.
description_en: Allah is free of any imperfection and anything that does not befit His majesty and the One who has no partners. All creation glorifies and declares Him free of any imperfection due to His perfect and beautiful names and attributes.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.25; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

proof_text: The Master is Allah.
aqeedah_belief: He is the One and Unique for whom there is no partner or equal.
salah_usage: Stand in salah as a devoted servant before the absolute Master of all — let this awareness remove all false pride.
dua_usage: Act as a true servant to the true Master.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya As-Sayyid untuk memperkukuh rasa kehambaan agar hati sedar bahawa kita adalah hamba yang sentiasa memerlukan-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Act as a true servant to the true Master.
ghazali_insight: This name denotes that Allah is the absolute owner and master of the entire universe. It is a profound reminder that all creation are His devoted servants who remain in a state of absolute and total need of Him.
description_en: He is the One and Unique for whom there is no partner or equal.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.157; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

aqeedah_belief: He is the Master of all creation and all creation without exception are His slaves who turn to none but Him and who act by His command.
salah_usage: Supplicate in salah for healing of the heart and body, trusting that true cure belongs to Him alone.
dua_usage: Seek medical treatment but believe the cure comes only from Him
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Ash-Shaafee ketika sakit atau ditimpa kesusahan agar hati berserah kepada-Nya sebagai satu-satunya penyembuh yang hakiki.
when_to_invoke: Seek medical treatment but believe the cure comes only from Him
ghazali_insight: Allah alone can remove pain and harm from the hearts and bodies of His servants. True healing is exclusively in His hands — He cures whomever He wills, and none can cure except Him.
description_en: He is the Master of all creation and all creation without exception are His slaves who turn to none but Him and who act by His command.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.155; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

proof_text: O people! Allah is Pure and, therefore, accepts only that which is pure. …
aqeedah_belief: He is the real provider. No one can withhold what He gives, nor can anyone give what He withholds. There is no limit to what He gives, and whatever He gives reaches all His creation.
salah_usage: Purify your intention before salah, knowing that He is At-Tayyib — the Pure One who accepts only what is pure.
dua_usage: Ensure your income and food are Halal (pure).
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya At-Tayyib sebelum berdoa agar hati bersih daripada riya' dan niat yang tidak ikhlas kepada-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Ensure your income and food are Halal (pure).
ghazali_insight: This name denotes the One who is absolutely perfect and rightfully free from any deficiency or shortcoming. It guides believers to recognise and revere the flawless purity inherent in Allah's essence and in all His actions.
description_en: He is the real provider. No one can withhold what He gives, nor can anyone give what He withholds. There is no limit to what He gives, and whatever He gives reaches all His creation.

english_meaning: The One Who acts in a good and fine manner
proof_hadith: Reported by At-Tirmidhee and Abu Daawood
aqeedah_belief: Allah always covers His slaves' faults and never exposes them. He also likes them to conceal their sins and avoid whatever is bound to dishonour them, being aware of His presence and showing Him the respect due to Him.
salah_usage: Perform your salah with excellence (ihsan), knowing that Al-Muhsin sees and appreciates every perfect detail of your worship.
dua_usage: Practice *Ihsan* (excellence) in worship and dealings.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Al-Muhsin untuk mengingatkan diri bahawa Allah mahu kita berbuat baik dalam setiap perkara, sekecil mana pun.
when_to_invoke: Practice *Ihsan* (excellence) in worship and dealings.
ghazali_insight: Al-Muhsin is the One who acts with absolute excellence, ensuring that all of His actions and decrees are flawlessly perfect. This name instils deep trust in the believer, teaching them to recognise the inherent goodness and fine manner in everything Allah ordains.
description_en: Allah always covers His slaves' faults and never exposes them. He also likes them to conceal their sins and avoid whatever is bound to dishonour them, being aware of His presence and showing Him the respect due to Him.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.149; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

proof_text: …Allah is the Giver and I am Al-Qaasim (i.e. the distributor) …
aqeedah_belief: He has the best and perfect qualities. He is Beautiful in His Being, and all His names, attributes and actions are also beautiful.
salah_usage: Ask abundantly in salah — He is Al-Mu'tee, the Giver whose treasure is never diminished by giving.
dua_usage: Acknowledge that all you have is a gift from Him.
dhikr_usage: Sebut Ya Al-Mu'tee dalam doa selepas solat agar hati sentiasa mengharapkan pemberian-Nya dan tidak bergantung kepada selain-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Acknowledge that all you have is a gift from Him.
ghazali_insight: Allah is the ultimate bestower who provides to whomever is deserving of His gifts. This name teaches the believer to recognise Allah as the sole source of all provision and to rely upon Him to fulfil their every need.
description_en: He has the best and perfect qualities. He is Beautiful in His Being, and all His names, attributes and actions are also beautiful.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.165; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

proof_text: O Allah! I ask You by virtue of the fact that all praise is due to You; none has the right to be worshiped but You, the Bestower…
aqeedah_belief: He gives abundantly to all His creatures without exception and bestows on them His kindness and countless graces and blessings. He exclusively bestows on the righteous believers certain blessings in this life and in the hereafter.
salah_usage: Count His blessings in salah, recognising that every good you have is an unearned gift from Al-Mannaan.
dua_usage: Do not remind people of your favors to them (don't be a *mannan*), for true bestowal is from Allah.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Al-Mannaan sebagai ungkapan syukur agar hati sentiasa sedar bahawa segala nikmat adalah anugerah percuma dari-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Do not remind people of your favors to them (don't be a *mannan*), for true bestowal is from Allah.
ghazali_insight: Al-Mannaan is the Beneficent Bestower from whom every single favour, blessing, and gift ultimately originates. Reflecting on this name fills the believer with immense gratitude, acknowledging that every good in their life is a direct, unearned bounty generously granted by Him alone.
description_en: He gives abundantly to all His creatures without exception and bestows on them His kindness and countless graces and blessings. He exclusively bestows on the righteous believers certain blessings in this life and in the hereafter.
source_reference: Shaykh Uthaymeen list-of-the-99-names-of-allaah-shaykh-uthaymeen-dawud-burbank.pdf; Booklet en_The_Beautiful_Names_of_Allah.pdf p.145; Comprehensive MD Divine Names_ A Comprehensive Guide to the 99 Attributes.md

english_meaning: The One Who has no partner nor anyone like Him
proof_text: Surely, Allah is Al-Witr (i.e. One who has no equal), and He likes Al-Witr [prayer].
aqeedah_belief: Modesty, as a divine attribute, is a perfect quality befitting none but Him and suits His majesty and greatness to the exclusion of all creation. This modesty is in no way similar to modesty displayed by any of His creatures, for it denotes His all-encompassing mercy, perfect grace and kindness, and
salah_usage: Pray Witr as its namesake — the odd-numbered salah honouring the One who is uniquely singular with no partner.
dua_usage: Perform Witr prayers; value uniqueness and Oneness.
dhikr_usage: Zikirkan Ya Al-Witr dalam solat witir agar hati sentiasa mengakui keesaan Allah yang mutlak dan tiada sebarang sekutu bagi-Nya.
when_to_invoke: Perform Witr prayers; value uniqueness and Oneness.
ghazali_insight: Allah is the absolutely unique One who has no partner, helper, or equal. He is singular in His self, His attributes, and His actions — deepening the believer's understanding of His peerless oneness.
description_en: Modesty, as a divine attribute, is a perfect quality befitting none but Him and suits His majesty and greatness to the exclusion of all creation. This modesty is in no way similar to modesty displayed by any of His creatures, for it denotes His all-encompassing mercy, perfect grace and kindness, and great forgiveness and forbearance.
